t: My Agentic Workflow: From Tedious TUI to a True CLI
s: The author details a workflow shift from manual TUIs to agentic CLI interactions, focusing on a refactor to make an application's homepage configurable. This involves a 'Prompt Fu' technique of selectively providing codebase context to an AI for implementation planning.
sub: Agentic workflow development with AI assistants
Selective context provisioning for LLMs ('Prompt Fu')
Transitioning from TUI to CLI interaction with AI
